sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: L2: stable surface expression of FLAG-CD97 in BHK-21 cells confirmed (cell line establishment assay); no functional assay cited in clip. L3: surface detection of FLAG-CD97 in GBM cells confirmed; no functional assay cited in clip.
sites.rationale: ADGRE5 has a signal peptide spanning residues 1–20 (computed landmarks); the mature N-terminus begins at residue 21 (Q). An N-terminal FLAG tag on the full-length receptor must therefore be inserted after residue 20 (T), placing it at the extracellular face of the large NTF (residues 21–551, >530 aa from TM1). This is the only extracellular terminus of the protein, so the junction is topology-derived from the single qualifying terminus. Python confirmed residue 20 = T and residue 21 = Q. L3 (PMC10481366) independently corroborates the same N-terminal FLAG placement on full-length CD97. L2 (PMC12965680): FLAG-tagged full-length CD97 (ADGRE5) stably expressed in BHK-21 cells, with surface-displayed FLAG-tagged CD97 confirmed. L3 (PMC10481366) independently corroborates: full-length CD97 in GBM cells with FLAG explicitly placed at the N-terminus to detect exogenously expressed CD97 at the cell surface. Neither paper names a specific residue number.

sources.claim: (A) The establishment of a BHK-21 cell line stably expressing Flag-tagged CD97 was achieved.

literature_notes: L1 (PMC11330365) was considered but does not qualify. It describes chimeric MBP-CTF constructs in which the entire NTF of ADGRE5 (residues 21–~529) is replaced by a heterologous signal sequence + HA tag + MBP + TEV site preceding the CTF. Although the CTF is membrane-anchored (contains the 7TM domain), the HA tag sits at the N-terminus of the chimeric protein and does not correspond to any specific residue in the native full-length ADGRE5 sequence; its position cannot be mapped to an insert_after_residue in the canonical protein. This is analogous to the 'commercial plasmid whose tag position is unstated' exclusion — the tag is real but unpinnable in the native sequence. L2 and L3 both pin the same junction (N-terminus after signal peptide cleavage) and therefore represent one site, not two; L2 is used as the primary supporting clip because it documents a stable cell line with confirmed surface display, and L3 is noted as corroboration in the evidence_detail.
